# Cobblestone

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing) · [Uses](#used-to-make)

<a href="Item-cobblestone.md" title="Cobblestone"><img src="icons/22.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Cobblestone"></a>

Rough stone used for stone tools, furnaces and construction. Smelting it produces [Stone](Item-stone.md).

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Required mining tool | Wood pickaxe or better |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Gather by mining [Stone](Item-stone.md). Follow each block’s tool requirement.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
